title: The Blank Page at the End of Class
fact_notes: 登場人物・場所・出来事は架空の教材例。特定の研究結果・制度・医学的助言を示すものではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Every Thursday, Mr. Lee gave his students a short reading task.
sentences.ja: 毎週木曜日、リー先生は生徒に短い読解課題を出した。

sentences.en: They read an article and answered questions in their notebooks.
sentences.ja: 生徒は記事を読み、ノートに質問の答えを書いた。

sentences.en: Most students finished before the end of the lesson.
sentences.ja: ほとんどの生徒は授業が終わる前に終えた。

sentences.en: However, they often forgot what they had learned by Friday.
sentences.ja: しかし金曜日までには学んだ内容をよく忘れていた。

sentences.en: One day, the teacher introduced a different activity after reading.
sentences.ja: ある日、先生は読解後に別の活動を導入した。

sentences.en: He asked everyone to close their books and take a blank sheet.
sentences.ja: 全員に本を閉じ、白紙を一枚取るよう求めた。

sentences.en: They had three minutes to write anything they could remember.
sentences.ja: 覚えていることを何でも書く時間が3分間あった。

sentences.en: They did not need to write perfect sentences or use difficult words.
sentences.ja: 完璧な文や難しい単語を使う必要はなかった。

sentences.en: Sara remembered the main character but forgot an important event.
sentences.ja: サラは主人公を覚えていたが、重要な出来事を忘れた。

sentences.en: Her partner remembered the event but could not explain its meaning.
sentences.ja: ペアの相手は出来事を覚えていたが、その意味を説明できなかった。

sentences.en: Then they opened their books and checked their own notes.
sentences.ja: それから本を開き、自分のメモを確認した。

sentences.en: Each student found something that needed more attention.
sentences.ja: 生徒はそれぞれ、さらに注意を向ける必要のある内容を見つけた。

sentences.en: The next week, Sara changed how she reviewed her lessons.
sentences.ja: 翌週、サラは授業の復習方法を変えた。

sentences.en: Instead of only looking at her notes, she tried to recall key ideas.
sentences.ja: ノートを見るだけでなく、重要な考えを思い出そうとした。

sentences.en: When she could not remember something, she checked that part again.
sentences.ja: 何かを思い出せないときは、その部分を再確認した。

sentences.en: She started to notice which topics were still difficult for her.
sentences.ja: どの話題がまだ難しいのか気づき始めた。

sentences.en: At the end of the month, the teacher asked for feedback.
sentences.ja: 月末、先生は感想を求めた。

sentences.en: Sara said the blank page had helped her find gaps in her understanding.
sentences.ja: サラは白紙のおかげで理解の抜けに気づけたと言った。

sentences.en: She did not expect every student to use the same method.
sentences.ja: すべての生徒が同じ方法を使うことを期待したわけではない。

sentences.en: For her, the simple activity was a useful way to plan further study.
sentences.ja: 彼女にとってその簡単な活動は今後の学習を計画する有益な方法だった。

questions.prompt: When did Mr. Lee usually give a reading task?
What problem did students often have?
options: They forgot what they had learned.
questions.explanation_ja: 翌日には学んだことを忘れがちだった。

questions.prompt: What did students use for the new activity?
questions.explanation_ja: 白紙に覚えていることを書いた。

questions.prompt: How much time did they have?

questions.explanation_ja: 重要な出来事を忘れた。

questions.prompt: Why did the students open their books again?
options: To check what they remembered and missed.
questions.explanation_ja: メモと本文を照合し、注意すべき点を発見した。
記憶から思い出すという意味。

questions.prompt: What did Sara do when she could not remember something?
questions.explanation_ja: 思い出せない部分を再確認した。

questions.prompt: How did the activity help Sara?
options: It revealed what she did not understand well.
questions.explanation_ja: 理解の抜けを見つけた。

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: All students should study in exactly the same way.
Trying to remember independently can reveal what to review.
questions.explanation_ja: 思い出す活動によって次の復習の重点を見つける。

受動的に見るだけの復習と想起を対比。
サラ個人の経験に限定する。

paraphrases.source: They did not need to write perfect sentences or use difficult words.
paraphrases.rewrite: Correct sentences and advanced vocabulary were not necessary.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 正確な文や難しい語彙は必須ではない。

paraphrases.source: Each student found something that needed more attention.
paraphrases.rewrite: Every learner discovered an area to focus on more.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 各生徒がより注意すべき点を見つけた。

paraphrases.source: When she could not remember something, she checked that part again.
paraphrases.rewrite: If she forgot a point, she looked at it again.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 忘れた点を再確認した。

paraphrases.source: Sara said the blank page had helped her find gaps in her understanding.
paraphrases.rewrite: Sara said that writing without notes showed her what she had not fully understood.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 白紙の活動が理解不足を示した。
